name: StarPort completed class exchange directions
description: Runs the actual port-construction scheduler for all eight approved classes and verifies the completed class, trade direction and initial stock persisted in PostgreSQL.

tests.name: Enable deterministic scheduling only in the disposable database

data.sql: INSERT INTO config(key,value,type) VALUES('test.deterministic_scheduler_enabled','1','int') ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value='1',type='int';

tests.name: Create eight due construction fixtures and their remaining delivery materials

data.sql: WITH target AS (SELECT sector_id,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY sector_id)::int AS class_no FROM sectors s WHERE s.sector_id>10 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ports p WHERE p.is_active AND p.sector_id=s.sector_id) ORDER BY sector_id LIMIT 8), worlds AS (INSERT INTO planets(num,sector_id,name,owner_id,owner_type,class,created_by) SELECT 1,t.sector_id,'v3_class_direction_'||t.class_no,p.player_id,'player','M',p.player_id FROM target t CROSS JOIN players p WHERE p.name='planet_gov' RETURNING planet_id,sector_id), stock AS (INSERT INTO entity_stock(entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code,quantity,price) SELECT 'planet',w.planet_id,c.code,100,0 FROM worlds w CROSS JOIN (VALUES('ORE'),('ORG'),('EQU')) c(code) RETURNING entity_id), constructions AS (INSERT INTO planet_port_constructions(request_id,player_id,planet_id,sector_id,port_class,deliveries_completed,deliveries_required,delivery_amount,delivery_interval_seconds,next_delivery_at,status) SELECT 'class-direction-'||t.class_no,p.player_id,w.planet_id,w.sector_id,t.class_no,2,3,100,86400,to_timestamp(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()))+3600),'building' FROM target t JOIN worlds w USING(sector_id) CROSS JOIN players p WHERE p.name='planet_gov' RETURNING construction_id) SELECT ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM target)=8 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM worlds)=8 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock)=24 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM constructions)=8)::int;

tests.name: Isolate only the construction scheduler task in this disposable database

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET enabled=(name='port_construction'),next_due_at=CASE WHEN name='port_construction' THEN now()+interval '1 hour' ELSE now()+interval '3 days' END;

tests.name: Advance the actual registered scheduler by one simulated day
Verify each completed class retains its fixed buy/sell exchange pattern and initial stock

data.sql: WITH expected(class_no,ore_mode,org_mode,equ_mode) AS (VALUES (1,'sell','buy','buy'),(2,'sell','sell','buy'),(3,'buy','sell','sell'),(4,'buy','sell','buy'),(5,'buy','buy','sell'),(6,'sell','buy','sell'),(7,'buy','buy','buy'),(8,'sell','sell','sell')) SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=8 AND COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE c.status='completed' AND p.is_active AND p.type=e.class_no AND ore.mode=e.ore_mode AND org.mode=e.org_mode AND equ.mode=e.equ_mode AND ore_stock.quantity=CASE WHEN e.ore_mode='buy' THEN 0 ELSE (p.size*1000*75/100)::bigint END AND org_stock.quantity=CASE WHEN e.org_mode='buy' THEN 0 ELSE (p.size*1000*75/100)::bigint END AND equ_stock.quantity=CASE WHEN e.equ_mode='buy' THEN 0 ELSE (p.size*1000*75/100)::bigint END)=8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM expected e JOIN planet_port_constructions c ON c.request_id='class-direction-'||e.class_no JOIN ports p ON p.port_id=c.port_id JOIN port_trade ore ON ore.port_id=p.port_id AND ore.commodity='ORE' JOIN port_trade org ON org.port_id=p.port_id AND org.commodity='ORG' JOIN port_trade equ ON equ.port_id=p.port_id AND equ.commodity='EQU' JOIN entity_stock ore_stock ON ore_stock.entity_type='port' AND ore_stock.entity_id=p.port_id AND ore_stock.commodity_code='ORE' JOIN entity_stock org_stock ON org_stock.entity_type='port' AND org_stock.entity_id=p.port_id AND org_stock.commodity_code='ORG' JOIN entity_stock equ_stock ON equ_stock.entity_type='port' AND equ_stock.entity_id=p.port_id AND equ_stock.commodity_code='EQU';

tests.name: Disable deterministic scheduling after the isolated acceptance

data.sql: UPDATE config SET value='0' WHERE key='test.deterministic_scheduler_enabled' AND type='int';
